deadline.value: Funded places have their own deadlines (see the funding pages); self-funded overseas applicants for September 2027 should apply with a complete application by 30 June 2027.
deadline.quote: Please check our Postgraduate Funding for details of funding application deadlines. Applications from self-funded students are welcomed and have no fixed deadline.

also.quote: if you wish to join in September 2027, please apply with a complete application by 30 June 2027 if you are an overseas student

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must name one or two supervisors on the application, and are advised to email them first.
supervisor.quote: It is compulsory to indicate the names of one or two supervisors whose research interests you. We recommend that you contact these Supervisors by email in advance of making your application.

funding.value: An offer of admission is separate from any offer of funding; funded places are listed on the Faculty website.
funding.quote: Offer letters for programmes do not represent any intention to fund. The offer of admission is separate to any offer of funding.

entry_route.value: A first or upper-second honours degree (or international equivalent) in a biomedical science or related discipline.
entry_route.quote: A first or upper second-class honours degree (or international equivalent) in a biomedical science or related discipline is required for entry to the PhD programme.

toefl_min.value: English profile C. TOEFL iBT tests from 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills (older tests: 88 overall).
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level C.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.5 in all skills (profile C).

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level C.
